notes.title: v1.18.1280 - Peace Edition
notes.content:
This patch comes with a new logo, some balance and other fixes including a core Unreal Engine + SteamCore component upgrade + Steam Cloud Sync fixes!.   

The new SteamCore integration will allow for STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS + LEADER BOARDS (joy!). I will be adding some to the game ASAP!

[h2]PATCH NOTES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] SteamCore session system implemented
[*] BUFF: The Talisman RET 0 to  1
[*] BUFF: Big & Beardy protects all buds not just plants 
[*] Neem Gleem card description updated
[*] ABILITY FIX: Buff target retaliation power
[*] Removed single player Countdown to match start
[*] QOL: Deck Builder UI tweaked
[*] NEW LOGO :D
[*] AUDIO CHANNEL MIXER FIXES: Buff attack, Skull Tattoo, Dragon Tattoo
[*] Level up card pick loop limited to 7 seconds
[*] FIX: bowl shield remaining when not protected
[/list]

Please do drop into our Discord to report any bugs (or just say HIGH!) 

[h2]COMING ASAP[/h2]
[list]
[*] Leaderboards (XP)
[*] Achievements (wins / combos / played 'hands')
[*] Improved / reworked card 'art'
[*] New cards / Balance 
[/list]

I hope people are enjoying the game and will be posting another patch real soon!
- Jono (goa_gamer)

notes.title: 'PEACE PATCH' ROLLUP #1 - NEW CARDS! + FIXES + GAME BALANCE
notes.content:
[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
Most people who have played over 10+ hours are saying they WANT MORE CARDS - so this update I have created 6 new cards !

Drop into the Discord to keep up to date / supply feedback.

[list]
[*] 'Torch Lighter' - extra damage v buds
[*] 'The Talisman' - supports Mystical class cards
[*] 'White Widow' - extra damage vs possie with additional drop combos
[*] 'Dragon Tattoo' - target own possie +1 ToKe, +1 Tolerance ~ single use
[*] 'Guinae Pigs!' - this card just had to be made... [ON DROP] repeated clone
[*] 'Double Jointed' - forgot I already rolled one... clone player joint on board
[/list]

notes.title: LAUNCHED INTO THE WILD!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44942687/7cb823eb4f7af0c3bd2d0a4928b655f957b17e8c.png[/img]

I'm happy to announce the free 'Peace Edition' of my card game Bud Masters is now available on Steam for download!

Do follow to keep up to date on any changes to the game, new cards and special events!

Please do report any card issues that I may have missed in the Steam Community Forums and I will get them fixed up ASAP!

All feedback is welcome, and if you have ideas for new cards please or other suggestions please do post or join us on our Discord!

I hope you have some fun playing!
  
GLHF + PLUR!
- Jono

notes.title: 420 LAUNCH DELAYED
notes.content:
Looks like I have missed the 420 launch with a few issues to sort out my end.   My apologies if you had an event planned around the 420 launch!

If you haven't already, please do still WISHLIST the game and you will be notified as soon as the FREE 'Peace Edition' is released!

It should not take too long 3-5 days at most.   All of the launch issues have hopefully been resolved and just waiting for the Steam Team to get back to me after the weekend.

While we missed the launch, I'm still super happy things are progressing!

Happy 420! and I hope you are enjoying some good music, good friends, and a pleasant journey to wherever you may be going :D

Peace out!
- Jono
